barrier_policy.session_close: Truncate holding horizon at the exchange close; report SESSION_END separately, with effective horizon. A signal at/after close has NO_SESSION_ENTRY.
barrier_policy.ordering: Check each contiguous positive-volume OHLC bar in chronological order. A boundary-crossing OPEN precedes its high/low. Otherwise simultaneous target and stop is AMBIGUOUS_BOTH, never a win or forced stop. A gap before resolution is UNKNOWN_PATH_GAP; later bars cannot repair it. Resolution before a later gap remains known. Target intrabar exit proxy is threshold; stop gaps use opening price. Outcome times are intervals, not exact ticks.

entry_policy.method: First minute open at or after signal + latency, ceil to minute boundary. No fill assumed within the already-started minute. Exact entry minute required; missing/zero-volume/invalid data stays unknown. BAR_PROXY_NOT_EXECUTABLE.

availability: Explicit FINAL_BARS_AVAILABLE_AT_MINUTE_END_SCENARIO; source receipt/revision times absent. Feature reader must respect available_at when supplied and ignore unfinished/future bars.
limits: All 322 frozen discovery-audit events; no winners-only selection or exclusions by old scorability. This 96-symbol sample is NOT a qualified historical NASDAQ under-100M universe.
